figures.name: Fig7_true_3D_components
figures.caption: Full final extents, actual coordinates ×1 with independently fitted axis ranges. Inverse-case free nodes travel tens of millimeters under dead reference traction without solved fluid drag; this is not vessel transport. Spatial neighbors/contact pairs never define fragments. Colors may cycle for numerous small components.
